title: Practice 1: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Look! The airplane is taking off.
exercises.why: **взлетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of взлетать: imperfective (perfective partner: взлететь).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).
**взбежала** — past tense (feminine) of взбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: взбегать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Look! There's a plane taking off.
exercises.why: **взлетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of взлетать: imperfective (perfective partner: взлететь).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: In the east, the sun rises.
exercises.why: **всходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of всходить: imperfective (perfective partner: взойти).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: One day, the truth will be revealed.
exercises.why: **всплывёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of всплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: всплывать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Sooner or later, the truth'll come out.
exercises.why: **всплывёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of всплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: всплывать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Yanni ascended to the throne of the kingdom.
exercises.why: **взошёл** — past tense (masculine) of взойти: perfective (imperfective partner: всходить).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The jet plane took off in an instant.
exercises.why: **взлетел** — past tense (masculine) of взлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: взлетать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: A helicopter is able to take off and land straight up and down.
exercises.why: **взлетать** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: взлететь).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: Пауки ___ (наводить / навести, 3rd pl.) на неё ужас.
exercises.why: **наводят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of наводить: imperfective (perfective partner: навести).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Том ___ (наводить / навести, 3rd sg.) на меня скуку.
exercises.why: **наводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of наводить: imperfective (perfective partner: навести).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Том ___ (навести / наводить, past m. sg.) на меня дробовик.
exercises.why: **навёл** — past tense (masculine) of навести: perfective (imperfective partner: наводить).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: Tom leveled a shotgun at me.

exercises.q: Их корабль ___ (налететь / налетать, past m. sg.) на скалу.
exercises.why: **налетел** — past tense (masculine) of налететь: perfective (imperfective partner: налетать).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: ___ (навести / наводить, imper. sg.) микроскоп на резкость.
exercises.why: **наведи** — imperative (ты, singular) of навести: perfective (imperfective partner: наводить).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: У неё ___ (набежать / набегать, past pl.) слёзы на глаза.
exercises.why: **набежали** — past tense (plural) of набежать: perfective (imperfective partner: набегать).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: The tears began to gather in her eyes.

exercises.why: **всплывёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of всплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: всплывать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: One day, the truth will be revealed.

exercises.q: Янни ___ (взойти / всходить, past m. sg.) на трон королевства.
exercises.why: **взошёл** — past tense (masculine) of взойти: perfective (imperfective partner: всходить).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: Yanni ascended to the throne of the kingdom.

exercises.q: Рано или поздно правда ___ (всплыть / всплывать, 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **всплывёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of всплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: всплывать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: Sooner or later, the truth'll come out.

exercises.q: Закрой окна, а то комары ___ (налететь / налетать, 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **налетят** — future tense (3rd person plural) of налететь: perfective (imperfective partner: налетать).  Prefix **на-**: movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: Close the windows. Otherwise, mosquitoes will get in.
